authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. MHCLG Planning Data local-plan specification formally links local-plan records to local-plan-boundary references and responsible organisation codes; current entity pages expose exact boundary references, local-planning-authority identifiers and organisation CURIEs. This strengthens exact-identifier evidence but the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still supplies no authoritative local-plan reference, boundary reference, LPA/LAD identifier/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any returned authority/entity would therefore be guessing. No coverage_area_id is bound, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
